_note: Fixed before compiling or evolving. A = behaviour only (body is free: what body does the behaviour select?). B = body words + behaviour words (does the robot satisfy both?).

A.A_hop: hop: keep all feet off the ground as much as possible

B.B_six_forward: a six-legged robot that walks forward
B.B_two_forward: a two-legged robot that walks forward
B.B_longleg_hop: a robot with long legs that hops
B.B_low_wide_turn: a low robot with a wide body and short legs that turns left on the spot
B.B_four_right: a four-legged robot that walks sideways to the right
B.B_tall_nohop: a tall robot that walks forward without hopping
